items.name: camera-lib
items.title: Camera Support
items.description: Camera capture types, browser permission constants, and scan-overlay guide presets shared by the camera component and hook.

items.name: code-presentation
items.title: Code Presentation
items.description: Shiki highlighting and Prettier formatting pipeline that powers code block rendering and copy-ready output.

items.name: color-picker-lib
items.title: Color Picker Math
items.description: Color parsing, format conversion, and accessible-contrast math powering the color picker component and hook.

items.name: component-defaults
items.title: Component Defaults
items.description: Resolves component default props from context providers and explicit overrides across the kit.

items.name: component-item-keys
items.title: Component Item Keys
items.description: Stable key derivation for list-based components such as alert dialog, field, kanban, and split view.

items.name: component-native-props
items.title: Component Native Props
items.description: Filters custom component props out of native element prop spreads so DOM attributes stay clean.

items.name: component-prop-guards
items.title: Component Prop Guards
items.description: Type guards for callback and event props shared across components to keep prop forwarding type-safe.

items.name: component-refs
items.title: Component Refs
items.description: Merges multiple refs into a single callback ref for composed components such as code block and color picker.

items.name: data-table-helpers
items.title: Data Table Helpers
items.description: Sorting, filtering, and sample-data helpers used by the data table documentation demos.

items.name: layout-responsive
items.title: Responsive Layout
items.description: Responsive class composition for layout primitives like stack and spacer, driven by the kit CSS safelists.

items.name: view-transition
items.title: View Transition Utility
items.description: Reduced-motion-aware wrapper around the native View Transitions API: runs DOM updates inside document.startViewTransition when supported, and applies them instantly otherwise.
